slides.texte_overlay:
Signs you're becoming
a better man (even if
it doesn't feel like it)
You get bored of drama. Gossip, arguments over nothing, people who love chaos. When peace starts feeling better than excitement, you're growing up in the right direction.
You apologise faster. Not to keep the peace, but because you actually see your part now. Owning your mistakes quickly is one of the clearest signs of a mature man.
You keep promises to yourself. The workout, the early night, the savings. Doing what you said you'd do when nobody is watching is where real self-respect begins.
You're curious again. I started doing five minutes a day of history, art or science, and wanting to learn things for fun is a sign your mind is waking back up.
slides.texte_sophia: You're curious again. I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Learning for fun is a sign your mind is waking up.

slides.texte_overlay: You choose fewer, better friends. Less time with people who drain you, more with people who push you. A smaller circle isn't lonely, it's a sign you know your worth.
You handle bad days without wrecking everything. A rough morning no longer becomes a lost week. Bouncing back quicker is growth, even if it doesn't feel dramatic.
You're proud of others' wins. A friend gets promoted and you're genuinely happy for him. When comparison turns into celebration, you've become a stronger man.
